suggestions.summary: encodeOAuthState is identical to decodeOAuthState and returns undefined during OAuth initiation
suggestions.content: WHAT: encodeOAuthState now parses req.query.state and returns undefined when no state query is present, which is always true when generating the auth URL. WHY: Every add.ts handler calls encodeOAuthState(req) to embed teamId/returnTo in the OAuth state; with the bug the generated URL has state=undefined, so callback loses team context and returnTo. HOW: Restore original encode logic (read state from req body/session or req.query.returnTo/teamId and JSON.stringify it) instead of copying decode implementation.
suggestions.summaryPt: encodeOAuthState é idêntico a decodeOAuthState e retorna undefined durante o início do OAuth
suggestions.contentPt: O QUÊ: encodeOAuthState agora faz o parse de req.query.state e retorna undefined quando não há state na query, o que sempre acontece ao gerar a URL de autenticação. POR QUÊ: Todo handler add.ts chama encodeOAuthState(req) para embutir teamId/returnTo no state do OAuth; com o bug a URL gerada fica com state=undefined, então o callback perde o contexto do time e o returnTo. COMO: Restaurar a lógica original de encode (ler o state de req body/session ou req.query.returnTo/teamId e aplicar JSON.stringify) em vez de copiar a implementação do decode.

suggestions.summary: minimumTokenResponseSchema uses invalid computed property keys and strips expiry fields
suggestions.content: WHAT: minimumTokenResponseSchema is defined with `[z.string().toString()]: z.number()` which creates a literal property, not a Zod catchall, so all non-access_token fields are stripped. WHY: When credential sync is enabled the parsed token loses expiry_date/expires_in, causing isTokenExpiring checks to always treat token as expired and causing refresh loops. HOW: Use z.object({access_token: z.string()}).passthrough().or(z.record(z.string(), z.any())) or .catchall(z.number()) and explicitly allow expiry fields.
suggestions.summaryPt: minimumTokenResponseSchema usa chaves de propriedade computadas inválidas e remove os campos de expiração
suggestions.contentPt: O QUÊ: minimumTokenResponseSchema é definido com `[z.string().toString()]: z.number()`, o que cria uma propriedade literal, não um catchall do Zod, então todos os campos além de access_token são removidos. POR QUÊ: Quando a sincronização de credenciais está habilitada, o token parseado perde expiry_date/expires_in, fazendo as verificações de isTokenExpiring sempre tratarem o token como expirado e causando loops de refresh. COMO: Usar z.object({access_token: z.string()}).passthrough().or(z.record(z.string(), z.any())) ou .catchall(z.number()) e permitir explicitamente os campos de expiração.

suggestions.summary: parseRefreshTokenResponse returns SafeParse wrapper but GoogleCalendarService stores wrapper as key
suggestions.content: WHAT: parseRefreshTokenResponse returns the Zod SafeParseReturnType, but GoogleCalendarService assigns the whole wrapper to `key` and persists it. WHY: Credential key becomes {success:true,data:{access_token...}} so subsequent googleCredentialSchema.parse(credential.key) fails or reads undefined access_token. HOW: Either return parsed data directly (unwrap) or update caller to use `const parsed = parseRefreshTokenResponse(...); if(!parsed.success) throw; const key = parsed.data;` like Zoom/Office365 do.
suggestions.summaryPt: parseRefreshTokenResponse retorna o wrapper SafeParse, mas GoogleCalendarService armazena o wrapper como key
suggestions.contentPt: O QUÊ: parseRefreshTokenResponse retorna o SafeParseReturnType do Zod, mas GoogleCalendarService atribui o wrapper inteiro a `key` e o persiste. POR QUÊ: A key da credencial vira {success:true,data:{access_token...}}, então o googleCredentialSchema.parse(credential.key) seguinte falha ou lê access_token como undefined. COMO: Retornar diretamente os dados parseados (unwrap) ou atualizar o chamador para usar `const parsed = parseRefreshTokenResponse(...); if(!parsed.success) throw; const key = parsed.data;` como Zoom/Office365 fazem.

suggestions.summary: refreshOAuthTokens returns raw fetch Response but callers expect parsed token/data, causing TypeError
suggestions.content: WHAT: refreshOAuthTokens returns a raw fetch Response when sync is enabled, but every caller expects the original library shape (google res.data, axios .data, handleErrorsJson(Response)). WHY: Google does `res?.data.access_token` on a fetch Response → TypeError; Zoho-bigin/Office365 call handleErrorsJson/axios logic on wrong type. HOW: Normalize: after fetch check !response.ok throw, then return response.json() or return a Response-shaped object compatible with callers, or make sync endpoint return same shape as native refresh and parse it before returning.
suggestions.summaryPt: refreshOAuthTokens retorna o Response bruto do fetch, mas os chamadores esperam token/dados parseados, causando TypeError
suggestions.contentPt: O QUÊ: refreshOAuthTokens retorna um Response bruto do fetch quando a sincronização está habilitada, mas todo chamador espera o formato original da biblioteca (res.data do google, .data do axios, handleErrorsJson(Response)). POR QUÊ: O Google faz `res?.data.access_token` em um Response do fetch → TypeError; Zoho-bigin/Office365 chamam a lógica de handleErrorsJson/axios no tipo errado. COMO: Normalizar: após o fetch, verificar !response.ok e lançar erro, depois retornar response.json() ou um objeto no formato de Response compatível com os chamadores, ou fazer o endpoint de sync retornar o mesmo formato do refresh nativo e parseá-lo antes de retornar.

suggestions.summary: zoho-bigin passes credentialId as userId to sync endpoint and mismatches response type
suggestions.content: WHAT: Bigin refresh passes credential.id instead of credential.userId to refreshOAuthTokens, and then treats the returned fetch Response as an axios response. WHY: Sync endpoint receives credentialId as calcomUserId (wrong user) and caller crashes reading .data.error on a Response object. HOW: Pass credential's userId (or credential.userId) and handle both Response vs Axios shapes, or make refreshOAuthTokens return normalized json.
suggestions.summaryPt: zoho-bigin passa credentialId como userId para o endpoint de sync e o tipo da resposta não confere
suggestions.contentPt: O QUÊ: O refresh do Bigin passa credential.id em vez de credential.userId para refreshOAuthTokens e depois trata o Response do fetch retornado como uma resposta do axios. POR QUÊ: O endpoint de sync recebe credentialId como calcomUserId (usuário errado) e o chamador quebra ao ler .data.error em um objeto Response. COMO: Passar o userId da credencial (ou credential.userId) e tratar tanto o formato Response quanto o Axios, ou fazer refreshOAuthTokens retornar o json normalizado.

suggestions.summary: Salesforce CalendarService uses prisma without importing it and creates connection with stale token
suggestions.content: WHAT: Missing `import prisma from "@calcom/prisma"` causes runtime ReferenceError, and Connection is initialized with stale credentialKey instead of refreshed token. WHY: Refresh flow appears to succeed (DB updated) but subsequent Salesforce API calls use expired access_token and fail. HOW: Add prisma import, use `accessToken: accessTokenParsed.data.access_token` and `instanceUrl: accessTokenParsed.data.instance_url ?? credentialKey.instance_url`, and check !response.ok instead of statusText.
suggestions.summaryPt: CalendarService do Salesforce usa prisma sem importá-lo e cria a conexão com token desatualizado
suggestions.contentPt: O QUÊ: A falta de `import prisma from "@calcom/prisma"` causa ReferenceError em runtime, e a Connection é inicializada com o credentialKey desatualizado em vez do token renovado. POR QUÊ: O fluxo de refresh parece ter sucesso (banco atualizado), mas as chamadas seguintes à API do Salesforce usam um access_token expirado e falham. COMO: Adicionar o import do prisma, usar `accessToken: accessTokenParsed.data.access_token` e `instanceUrl: accessTokenParsed.data.instance_url ?? credentialKey.instance_url`, e verificar !response.ok em vez de statusText.

suggestions.summary: Webhook decrypt/parse throws unhandled, and refresh_token placeholder corrupts credentials
suggestions.content: WHAT: symmetricDecrypt/JSON.parse can throw and is uncaught, and parseRefreshTokenResponse injects a fake refresh_token that gets persisted. WHY: Invalid key or malformed payload crashes webhook with 500 instead of 400, and fake refresh_token later used for real refresh fails with invalid_grant. HOW: Wrap decrypt+parse in try/catch returning 400, and do not mutate data.refresh_token to placeholder — keep original refresh_token or leave undefined and handle missing case upstream.
suggestions.summaryPt: Decrypt/parse do webhook lança erro não tratado, e o placeholder de refresh_token corrompe as credenciais
suggestions.contentPt: O QUÊ: symmetricDecrypt/JSON.parse podem lançar erro sem tratamento, e parseRefreshTokenResponse injeta um refresh_token falso que é persistido. POR QUÊ: Uma chave inválida ou payload malformado derruba o webhook com 500 em vez de 400, e o refresh_token falso usado depois em um refresh real falha com invalid_grant. COMO: Envolver decrypt+parse em try/catch retornando 400, e não alterar data.refresh_token para um placeholder — manter o refresh_token original ou deixá-lo undefined e tratar o caso ausente a montante.

suggestions.summary: Webhook secret compared with !== enabling timing attack; needs timingSafeEqual.
suggestions.content: Direct !== comparison of webhook secret leaks timing. Use constant-time comparison (crypto.timingSafeEqual) with length-safe handling and fail-closed if secret not configured.
suggestions.summaryPt: Segredo do webhook comparado com !==, permitindo timing attack; precisa de timingSafeEqual.
suggestions.contentPt: A comparação direta com !== do segredo do webhook vaza informação de timing. Use comparação em tempo constante (crypto.timingSafeEqual) com tratamento seguro de tamanho e falhe de forma fechada (fail-closed) se o segredo não estiver configurado.

suggestions.summary: userId truthiness treats 0 as missing, bypassing credential sync
suggestions.content: Use explicit existence check `userId != null` instead of truthiness for numeric IDs. Same pattern at createOAuthAppCredential.ts:30 `if (state?.teamId)` should be `state?.teamId != null`.
suggestions.summaryPt: A verificação de truthiness de userId trata 0 como ausente, contornando a sincronização de credenciais
suggestions.contentPt: Use uma verificação explícita de existência `userId != null` em vez de truthiness para IDs numéricos. O mesmo padrão em createOAuthAppCredential.ts:30 `if (state?.teamId)` deve ser `state?.teamId != null`.

suggestions.summary: JSON.parse without try/catch throws unhandled on malformed OAuth state
suggestions.content: JSON.parse(req.query.state) at line 9 throws SyntaxError if state is not valid JSON (e.g. attacker-controlled or truncated). No catch, so the OAuth callback crashes with unhandled exception (500) instead of handled error. Same bug in encodeOAuthState.ts:9. Wrap in try/catch and return undefined / throw HttpError.
suggestions.summaryPt: JSON.parse sem try/catch lança erro não tratado com state OAuth malformado
suggestions.contentPt: JSON.parse(req.query.state) na linha 9 lança SyntaxError se o state não for um JSON válido (por exemplo, controlado por atacante ou truncado). Sem catch, o callback do OAuth quebra com exceção não tratada (500) em vez de um erro tratado. Mesmo bug em encodeOAuthState.ts:9. Envolver em try/catch e retornar undefined / lançar HttpError.

suggestions.summary: Unhandled symmetricDecrypt / JSON.parse crashes webhook
suggestions.content: symmetricDecrypt can throw if CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY is wrong/missing or ciphertext invalid, and JSON.parse throws if plaintext is not JSON. Both are outside any try/catch, so webhook throws unhandled 500 (also reqBody parse at line 31 uses .parse not .safeParse). Wrap in try/catch and return 400. Also consider zod safeParse.
suggestions.summaryPt: symmetricDecrypt / JSON.parse sem tratamento derrubam o webhook
suggestions.contentPt: symmetricDecrypt pode lançar erro se CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY estiver errada/ausente ou o ciphertext for inválido, e JSON.parse lança erro se o plaintext não for JSON. Ambos estão fora de qualquer try/catch, então o webhook lança 500 não tratado (além disso, o parse do reqBody na linha 31 usa .parse e não .safeParse). Envolver em try/catch e retornar 400. Considere também usar zod safeParse.

suggestions.summary: minimumTokenResponseSchema never matches valid tokens — always throws
suggestions.content: z.string().toString() evaluates to "[object Object]" (or "ZodString"), so schema requires a literal property with that name of type number, not any numeric expiry field. Valid responses with expiry_date/expires_in fail safeParse, causing parseRefreshTokenResponse to throw "Invalid refreshed tokens were returned" even on success when APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED is set. Use .catchall/.passthrough or z.record.
suggestions.summaryPt: minimumTokenResponseSchema nunca valida tokens válidos — sempre lança erro
suggestions.contentPt: z.string().toString() resulta em "[object Object]" (ou "ZodString"), então o schema exige uma propriedade literal com esse nome do tipo number, e não qualquer campo numérico de expiração. Respostas válidas com expiry_date/expires_in falham no safeParse, fazendo parseRefreshTokenResponse lançar "Invalid refreshed tokens were returned" mesmo em caso de sucesso quando APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED está definido. Use .catchall/.passthrough ou z.record.

suggestions.summary: refreshOAuthTokens return type mismatch causes TypeError on token refresh
suggestions.content: When sharing enabled refreshOAuthTokens returns fetch Response to CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT, but google path does res?.data -> undefined -> token is undefined -> token.access_token throws TypeError. Same mismatch in hubspot/msteams/webex etc. where caller expects parsed object but gets Response. Normalise return: either always return Response and callers handleErrorsJson, or always return parsed JSON.
suggestions.summaryPt: Incompatibilidade no tipo de retorno de refreshOAuthTokens causa TypeError no refresh do token
suggestions.contentPt: Com o compartilhamento habilitado, refreshOAuthTokens retorna o Response do fetch para CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT, mas o caminho do google faz res?.data -> undefined -> token é undefined -> token.access_token lança TypeError. Mesma incompatibilidade em hubspot/msteams/webex etc., onde o chamador espera um objeto parseado mas recebe um Response. Normalizar o retorno: ou sempre retornar Response e os chamadores usarem handleErrorsJson, ou sempre retornar JSON parseado.

suggestions.summary: JSDoc documents both appData.type and appData.appId as 'the app slug', contradicting code where type is credential type
suggestions.content: Documentation mismatch: @param appData.type and @param appData.appId both say 'the app slug'. In code type is the credential type (stored to credential.type) and appId is the slug (credential.appId). Duplicate phrase makes caller think they can pass slug for both. Update doc to distinguish type vs appId.
suggestions.summaryPt: O JSDoc documenta appData.type e appData.appId como 'o slug do app', contradizendo o código, onde type é o tipo da credencial
suggestions.contentPt: Incompatibilidade na documentação: @param appData.type e @param appData.appId dizem ambos 'the app slug'. No código, type é o tipo da credencial (armazenado em credential.type) e appId é o slug (credential.appId). A frase duplicada faz o chamador achar que pode passar o slug para ambos. Atualizar a documentação para distinguir type de appId.

suggestions.summary: parseRefreshTokenResponse called with merged googleCredentials instead of raw token response, contradicting its param name/doc
suggestions.content: Call-site disagrees with function contract: parseRefreshTokenResponse(response, schema) is documented to parse the raw refresh-token response, but GoogleCalendarService passes the merged googleCredentials object after mutating access_token/expiry_date. Validate token first, then merge, to keep name/behaviour aligned and avoid schema mismatch.
suggestions.summaryPt: parseRefreshTokenResponse é chamado com googleCredentials mesclado em vez da resposta bruta do token, contradizendo o nome/doc do parâmetro
suggestions.contentPt: O ponto de chamada discorda do contrato da função: parseRefreshTokenResponse(response, schema) está documentado para parsear a resposta bruta do refresh token, mas GoogleCalendarService passa o objeto googleCredentials mesclado após mutar access_token/expiry_date. Valide o token primeiro, depois faça o merge, para manter nome/comportamento alinhados e evitar incompatibilidade de schema.

suggestions.summary: Google stores SafeParseResult wrapper as credential key instead of parsed data
suggestions.content: Unwrap SafeParseResult: check success and use .data as key before prisma update, matching office365calendar handling.
suggestions.summaryPt: Google armazena o wrapper SafeParseResult como key da credencial em vez dos dados parseados
suggestions.contentPt: Faça o unwrap do SafeParseResult: verifique success e use .data como key antes do update do prisma, igual ao tratamento do office365calendar.

suggestions.summary: Hubspot expects HubspotToken but gets fetch Response when sharing enabled
suggestions.content: Normalize return: if result is Response parse JSON via handleErrorsJson, else use HubspotToken directly.
suggestions.summaryPt: Hubspot espera HubspotToken, mas recebe o Response do fetch quando o compartilhamento está habilitado
suggestions.contentPt: Normalizar o retorno: se o resultado for um Response, parsear o JSON via handleErrorsJson; caso contrário, usar o HubspotToken diretamente.

suggestions.summary: zoho-bigin passes credentialId as userId and mixes axios vs fetch response shapes
suggestions.content: Pass credential.userId and normalize Response vs axios shape before accessing .data.
suggestions.summaryPt: zoho-bigin passa credentialId como userId e mistura formatos de resposta axios e fetch
suggestions.contentPt: Passar credential.userId e normalizar o formato Response vs axios antes de acessar .data.

suggestions.summary: Google refresh expects GaxiosResponse .data but sync branch returns fetch Response
suggestions.content: Producer/consumer type mismatch: refreshOAuthTokens returns fetch Response when CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT is set, but GoogleCalendarService assumes GaxiosResponse with .data. When credential sharing is enabled, res?.data is undefined and access_token update crashes. Normalize the producer to return parsed JSON (or {data: json}) or branch the consumer to handle fetch Response (await res.json()).
suggestions.summaryPt: O refresh do Google espera .data do GaxiosResponse, mas o branch de sync retorna o Response do fetch
suggestions.contentPt: Incompatibilidade produtor/consumidor de tipo: refreshOAuthTokens retorna o Response do fetch quando CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT está definido, mas GoogleCalendarService assume um GaxiosResponse com .data. Com o compartilhamento de credenciais habilitado, res?.data é undefined e a atualização do access_token quebra. Normalizar o produtor para retornar JSON parseado (ou {data: json}) ou fazer o consumidor tratar o Response do fetch (await res.json()).

suggestions.summary: HubSpot refresh expects HubspotToken object but sync branch returns fetch Response
suggestions.content: Same producer/consumer mismatch as Google but with HubSpot SDK: hubspotClient returns a parsed token object, sync path returns fetch Response. Consumer must handle fetch Response (await response.json()) or producer must return parsed JSON to keep contract uniform.
suggestions.summaryPt: O refresh do HubSpot espera um objeto HubspotToken, mas o branch de sync retorna o Response do fetch
suggestions.contentPt: Mesma incompatibilidade produtor/consumidor do Google, mas com o SDK do HubSpot: hubspotClient retorna um objeto de token parseado, e o caminho de sync retorna o Response do fetch. O consumidor deve tratar o Response do fetch (await response.json()) ou o produtor deve retornar JSON parseado para manter o contrato uniforme.

suggestions.summary: Zoho Bigin expects AxiosResponse .data but sync returns fetch Response and wrong userId
suggestions.content: Two disagreements with the producer: (1) response shape – axios call returns {data:...} but sync fetch returns Response requiring .json(), so tokenInfo.data is undefined; (2) identity – producer expects userId to populate calcomUserId, consumer supplies credentialId. Fix by passing credential.userId and normalizing response (return parsed JSON or {data: json}) in the producer/consumer contract.
suggestions.summaryPt: Zoho Bigin espera .data do AxiosResponse, mas o sync retorna o Response do fetch e o userId errado
suggestions.contentPt: Duas divergências com o produtor: (1) formato da resposta – a chamada axios retorna {data:...}, mas o fetch de sync retorna um Response que exige .json(), então tokenInfo.data é undefined; (2) identidade – o produtor espera userId para preencher calcomUserId, mas o consumidor fornece credentialId. Corrigir passando credential.userId e normalizando a resposta (retornar JSON parseado ou {data: json}) no contrato produtor/consumidor.

suggestions.summary: Producer must normalize sync response shape to match heterogeneous refreshFunction returns
suggestions.content: Proposed producer fix (alternative to fixing each consumer): parse the sync endpoint response (await response.json()) and return it in the shape consumers expect, or wrap it as {data: json} and update consumers to handle one canonical shape. At minimum add Content-Type header and JSON parsing so sync and non-sync branches return the same kind of object.
suggestions.summaryPt: O produtor deve normalizar o formato da resposta de sync para corresponder aos retornos heterogêneos de refreshFunction
suggestions.contentPt: Correção proposta para o produtor (alternativa a corrigir cada consumidor): parsear a resposta do endpoint de sync (await response.json()) e retorná-la no formato que os consumidores esperam, ou envolvê-la como {data: json} e atualizar os consumidores para tratar um único formato canônico. No mínimo, adicionar o header Content-Type e o parse de JSON para que os branches com e sem sync retornem o mesmo tipo de objeto.

suggestions.summary: Stores SafeParse wrapper instead of parsed data
suggestions.content: Use parsed.data as credential key, e.g. const parsed = parseRefreshTokenResponse(...); data:{key: parsed.data}
suggestions.summaryPt: Armazena o wrapper SafeParse em vez dos dados parseados
suggestions.contentPt: Use parsed.data como key da credencial, por exemplo: const parsed = parseRefreshTokenResponse(...); data:{key: parsed.data}

suggestions.summary: minimumTokenResponseSchema computed literal key fails validation
suggestions.content: Replace with .catchall() / z.record() and validate numeric expiry exists.
suggestions.summaryPt: A chave literal computada em minimumTokenResponseSchema falha na validação
suggestions.contentPt: Substituir por .catchall() / z.record() e validar que a expiração numérica existe.

suggestions.summary: Sharing refresh returns Response but caller expects .data
suggestions.content: Normalize: parse Response via handleErrorsJson/json when sharing enabled, else use res.data.
suggestions.summaryPt: O refresh com compartilhamento retorna Response, mas o chamador espera .data
suggestions.contentPt: Normalizar: parsear o Response via handleErrorsJson/json quando o compartilhamento estiver habilitado; caso contrário, usar res.data.

suggestions.summary: Passes credentialId where userId expected
suggestions.content: Pass credential.userId instead of credentialId to refreshOAuthTokens.
suggestions.summaryPt: Passa credentialId onde userId é esperado
suggestions.contentPt: Passar credential.userId em vez de credentialId para refreshOAuthTokens.

suggestions.summary: Decrypt uses || "" fallback for AES key instead of fail-fast.
suggestions.content: Empty-string fallback for CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY is insecure. Fail-fast if key missing instead of decrypting with "" (weak/invalid AES256 key).
suggestions.summaryPt: Decrypt usa fallback || "" para a chave AES em vez de fail-fast.
suggestions.contentPt: O fallback de string vazia para CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY é inseguro. Falhe imediatamente (fail-fast) se a chave estiver ausente, em vez de descriptografar com "" (chave AES256 fraca/inválida).

suggestions.summary: encodeOAuthState name claims to encode but implementation decodes req.query.state and re-stringifies (identical to decode)
suggestions.content: Name/documentation mismatch: function is named encodeOAuthState but reads req.query.state and does JSON.parse/stringify, i.e. a decode + re-encode no-op. Its twin decodeOAuthState at _utils/oauth/decodeOAuthState.ts:5-11 does the same parse and returns the object. Callers (e.g. googlecalendar/api/add.ts) expect a true encoder (object → string). Rename to reflect reality or fix signature to encodeOAuthState(state: IntegrationOAuthCallbackState): string { return JSON.stringify(state); } and retain decode for the req path.
suggestions.summaryPt: O nome encodeOAuthState diz que codifica, mas a implementação decodifica req.query.state e faz stringify de novo (idêntico ao decode)
suggestions.contentPt: Incompatibilidade de nome/documentação: a função se chama encodeOAuthState, mas lê req.query.state e faz JSON.parse/stringify, ou seja, um decode + re-encode sem efeito. Sua gêmea decodeOAuthState em _utils/oauth/decodeOAuthState.ts:5-11 faz o mesmo parse e retorna o objeto. Os chamadores (por exemplo, googlecalendar/api/add.ts) esperam um encoder de verdade (objeto → string). Renomear para refletir a realidade ou corrigir a assinatura para encodeOAuthState(state: IntegrationOAuthCallbackState): string { return JSON.stringify(state); } e manter o decode para o caminho do req.

suggestions.summary: Env doc says AES256 needs 32 bytes but suggests openssl rand -base64 24 which generates only 24 bytes
suggestions.content: Name/doc mismatch in env template: comment claims 32-byte AES256 key required, but example command generates 24 bytes. Fix to `openssl rand -base64 32` (44 chars, 32 bytes decoded) to match the 32-byte requirement stated on the prior line.
suggestions.summaryPt: A doc de env diz que AES256 precisa de 32 bytes, mas sugere openssl rand -base64 24, que gera apenas 24 bytes
suggestions.contentPt: Incompatibilidade de nome/doc no template de env: o comentário afirma que uma chave AES256 de 32 bytes é necessária, mas o comando de exemplo gera 24 bytes. Corrigir para `openssl rand -base64 32` (44 caracteres, 32 bytes decodificados) para corresponder ao requisito de 32 bytes declarado na linha anterior.

groups.defect: When sync is enabled, refreshOAuthTokens returns a raw fetch Response, but callers (Google res.data, HubSpot token object, Zoho Bigin axios .data) expect their library's own shape. Zoho Bigin also passes credentialId where userId is expected.
GoogleCalendarService saves the whole SafeParseResult wrapper returned by parseRefreshTokenResponse as the credential key, instead of its .data.
In the webhook, symmetricDecrypt and JSON.parse can throw and are not caught, giving a 500. s_0d389f33 also reports that a placeholder refresh_token gets saved.

In parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts, minimumTokenResponseSchema uses computed keys like [z.string().toString()]. These create literal property names instead of a catchall or record, so the schema does not validate token responses as intended. Fix: use .catchall(), .passthrough() or z.record().
groups.arbiterReasoning:
All three suggestions point at the same lines (5-11/12) of minimumTokenResponseSchema. They report the same root defect: the computed keys `[z.string().toString()]` produce literal property names rather than dynamic-field validation. They also propose the same fix (catchall, passthrough or record). Grouping them is clear.

They describe the consequence differently. s_95664fc2 and s_0034d203 say valid tokens fail validation. s_ffe6d591 says expiry fields get stripped. In practice both computed keys stringify to the same literal, so the second definition (z.unknown().optional()) overrides the first, and the result is the stripping behavior. Still, these are two descriptions of the effect of one defect, not separate defects. One edit at one place resolves all of them, so I set needsUnifiedComment to false.

That last choice is the only judgment call here, and it is exactly where the two judges disagreed. That is why decisive is false.

groups.defect: encodeOAuthState copies decodeOAuthState: it parses req.query.state and re-stringifies it instead of building and encoding the OAuth state from the request's context, so it is not a real encoder.
groups.arbiterReasoning: Both suggestions point at the same lines (5-12) of encodeOAuthState.ts. They describe the same defect: the encoder is a copy of decodeOAuthState and does not encode anything. s_9b02e8e1 focuses on what happens as a result: when the OAuth flow starts there is no state in the query, so the function returns undefined and the teamId and returnTo values are lost. s_f297965f focuses on the mismatch between the function's name and what it does, a parse followed by a re-stringify that changes nothing. These are two views of one wrong implementation, and one rewrite of the function fixes both. Neither suggestion reports a separate extra defect, so a merged comment does not need to say more than either one already says.

secondCheck.reasonPt: Ambas reportam JSON.parse sem tratamento de exceções, causando 500 para entradas malformadas. Pode ser considerado um padrão sistêmico, embora processem entradas distintas: state OAuth e payload descriptografado do webhook.

Repete o problema concreto de JSON.parse lançar uma exceção não tratada para JSON inválido. O agrupamento depende de considerar esse tratamento ausente um padrão sistêmico entre os helpers OAuth e o webhook, que exigem edições separadas.

groups.defect: When sync is enabled, refreshOAuthTokens returns a raw fetch Response, but callers (Google res.data, HubSpot token object, Zoho Bigin axios .data) expect their library's own shape. Zoho Bigin also passes credentialId where userId is expected.
groups.rationale: All of these report the same mismatch between what refreshOAuthTokens returns and what its callers expect, either at the producer or at a consumer, and one normalization fixes it. The Bigin suggestions also report the credentialId-as-userId bug, which brings in s_c6985ceb through the overlap chain.

groups.defect: GoogleCalendarService saves the whole SafeParseResult wrapper returned by parseRefreshTokenResponse as the credential key, instead of its .data.
groups.rationale: All three describe the same wrapper being persisted as the Google credential key. One is reported from the helper's file and two from the caller.

groups.defect: minimumTokenResponseSchema uses computed keys like [z.string().toString()], which create literal property names instead of a catchall. As a result, validation fails or expiry fields get stripped.
groups.rationale: Same broken schema definition at the same lines. Each fix replaces it with catchall, passthrough or record.

groups.defect: In the webhook, symmetricDecrypt and JSON.parse can throw and are not caught, giving a 500. s_0d389f33 also reports that a placeholder refresh_token gets saved.
groups.rationale: Both report the unhandled decrypt/parse error at the same lines. s_0d389f33 adds the placeholder refresh_token problem.

groups.defect: encodeOAuthState copies decodeOAuthState: it parses req.query.state and re-stringifies it instead of actually encoding the state.
groups.rationale: Both describe the same wrong implementation of encodeOAuthState.

groups.defect: Google Calendar persists the SafeParse result wrapper as the credential key instead of its parsed data.
groups.rationale: All three describe the same persistence defect, pointing either at the Google caller or the helper that returns the wrapper.

groups.defect: Webhook decryption and input parsing failures escape unhandled, and the refresh-token parser inserts a fake refresh_token that can be persisted.
groups.rationale: Both report unhandled webhook decryption and JSON parsing errors. The first additionally reports placeholder refresh-token corruption, while the second also flags request-body parsing.

groups.defect: The sync refresh branch returns a fetch Response incompatible with consumers' native token-response shapes, and Zoho Bigin supplies a credential ID where the helper requires a user ID.
groups.rationale: The helper and consumer reports describe the same response-contract mismatch. The Bigin reports explicitly combine that mismatch with the incorrect identifier, linking the identifier-only suggestion into the group.

groups.defect: The minimum token schema uses computed literal property names instead of dynamic-field validation, producing invalid validation requirements and stripping expiry fields.
groups.rationale: All three identify the same malformed schema definition. The merged comment must retain both reported consequences: valid-token rejection and loss of expiry fields.

groups.defect: encodeOAuthState parses and reserializes existing request state instead of constructing OAuth state, contradicting its encoder contract and losing initiation context when that query parameter is absent.
groups.rationale: Both identify the copied decoding behavior as the encoder defect. Their combined coverage includes the encoder interface mismatch and the missing-state loss of teamId and returnTo.

suggestions.summary: Dummy totpCode lets backupCode login bypass password verification
suggestions.content: WHAT: Password verification is skipped when any totpCode is supplied (`if (user.password && !credentials.totpCode)`), so sending a valid backupCode + dummy totpCode bypasses password check. WHY: Attacker can call authorize with wrong password, correct backupCode, and `totpCode:"000000"` - the `!credentials.totpCode` guard is false so verifyPassword is not run, then the `if (user.twoFactorEnabled && credentials.backupCode)` branch succeeds and logs in. HOW: Always verify password when `user.password` exists regardless of totpCode/backupCode presence, or require both password and second factor independently (e.g. `if (user.password) await verifyPassword(...)`).
suggestions.summaryPt: totpCode fictício permite que login com backupCode ignore a verificação de senha
suggestions.contentPt: O QUÊ: A verificação de senha é ignorada quando qualquer totpCode é informado (`if (user.password && !credentials.totpCode)`), então enviar um backupCode válido + um totpCode fictício contorna a checagem de senha. POR QUÊ: Um atacante pode chamar authorize com senha errada, backupCode correto e `totpCode:"000000"` - o guard `!credentials.totpCode` é falso, então verifyPassword não é executado, e então o branch `if (user.twoFactorEnabled && credentials.backupCode)` é bem-sucedido e realiza o login. COMO: Sempre verifique a senha quando `user.password` existir, independentemente da presença de totpCode/backupCode, ou exija senha e segundo fator de forma independente (ex.: `if (user.password) await verifyPassword(...)`).

suggestions.summary: Uppercase backup codes incorrectly rejected due to case-sensitive compare
suggestions.content: WHAT: Backup code verification is case-sensitive (`replaceAll("-","")` only) while generated codes are lowercase hex (`crypto.randomBytes(5).toString("hex")` at setup.ts:61). WHY: User entering `ABCDE-FGHIJ` or pasting uppercase from email fails indexOf even though code is otherwise valid, causing incorrect_backup_code error and blocking disable/login. HOW: Normalize both sides: `req.body.backupCode.replaceAll("-","").toLowerCase()` and same at next-auth-options.ts:144.
suggestions.summaryPt: Backup codes em maiúsculas são rejeitados incorretamente devido à comparação case-sensitive
suggestions.contentPt: O QUÊ: A verificação do backup code é case-sensitive (apenas `replaceAll("-","")`), enquanto os códigos gerados são hex em minúsculas (`crypto.randomBytes(5).toString("hex")` em setup.ts:61). POR QUÊ: Um usuário que digita `ABCDE-FGHIJ` ou cola em maiúsculas a partir de um e-mail falha no indexOf mesmo que o código seja válido, causando o erro incorrect_backup_code e bloqueando o disable/login. COMO: Normalize ambos os lados: `req.body.backupCode.replaceAll("-","").toLowerCase()` e o mesmo em next-auth-options.ts:144.

suggestions.summary: Concurrent use of same backup code can succeed twice; null holes accumulate
suggestions.content: WHAT: Backup code consumption does non-atomic read-modify-write and nulls entry (`backupCodes[index]=null`) without filtering, allowing race reuse. WHY: Two concurrent logins with same backupCode both read array before either writes, both pass `indexOf` and both succeed; array then fills with nulls and later `indexOf` always misses but never returns MissingBackupCodes. HOW: Use atomic update or transaction/optimistic lock, and filter nulls: `backupCodes.splice(index,1)` or `backupCodes.filter(Boolean)` before re-encrypting, and handle all-null case as missing.
suggestions.summaryPt: Uso concorrente do mesmo backup code pode ter sucesso duas vezes; buracos de null se acumulam
suggestions.contentPt: O QUÊ: O consumo do backup code faz read-modify-write não atômico e define a entrada como null (`backupCodes[index]=null`) sem filtrar, permitindo reutilização por race. POR QUÊ: Dois logins concorrentes com o mesmo backupCode leem o array antes de qualquer um escrever, ambos passam no `indexOf` e ambos têm sucesso; o array então se enche de nulls e `indexOf` posteriores sempre falham, mas nunca retornam MissingBackupCodes. COMO: Use update atômico ou transaction/optimistic lock, e filtre os nulls: `backupCodes.splice(index,1)` ou `backupCodes.filter(Boolean)` antes de re-criptografar, e trate o caso de todos nulls como ausente.

suggestions.summary: Backup-code check uses indexOf/=== (timing leak) — use constant-time comparison.
suggestions.content: Direct string comparison of backup codes leaks timing via indexOf/===. Use constant-time comparison over all stored codes and normalize hex case. Without it an attacker with network timing can enumerate the 10 hex-char backup codes.
suggestions.summaryPt: A checagem de backup code usa indexOf/=== (timing leak) — use comparação em tempo constante.
suggestions.contentPt: A comparação direta de strings dos backup codes vaza informação de timing via indexOf/===. Use comparação em tempo constante sobre todos os códigos armazenados e normalize o case do hex. Sem isso, um atacante com medição de timing na rede pode enumerar os backup codes hex de 10 caracteres.

suggestions.summary: Disable-2FA backup-code check uses timing-variant indexOf — use constant-time compare.
suggestions.content: Same timing leak as login path: indexOf with === on backup codes allows timing oracle. Iterate all codes with crypto.timingSafeEqual and normalize to lower-case before compare.
suggestions.summaryPt: A checagem de backup code no disable-2FA usa indexOf com variação de timing — use comparação em tempo constante.
suggestions.contentPt: Mesmo timing leak do fluxo de login: indexOf com === nos backup codes permite um timing oracle. Itere sobre todos os códigos com crypto.timingSafeEqual e normalize para minúsculas antes de comparar.

suggestions.summary: Backup-code download test only checks filename, would pass with empty/broken file.
suggestions.content: Download assertion is too loose to fail: it only checks suggestedFilename. If backupCodes were empty, malformed, or Blob creation in EnableTwoFactorModal.tsx:95-99 failed, download would still have same filename and test would pass. Add content verification: read download, assert file contains 10 codes matching formatter /^\w{5}-\w{5}$/ and matches displayed codes.
suggestions.summaryPt: O teste de download do backup code só verifica o nome do arquivo, passaria com arquivo vazio/quebrado.
suggestions.contentPt: A asserção do download é frouxa demais para falhar: ela só verifica suggestedFilename. Se backupCodes estivesse vazio, malformado, ou se a criação do Blob em EnableTwoFactorModal.tsx:95-99 falhasse, o download ainda teria o mesmo nome de arquivo e o teste passaria. Adicione verificação de conteúdo: leia o download, valide que o arquivo contém 10 códigos que casam com o formato /^\w{5}-\w{5}$/ e que correspondem aos códigos exibidos.

suggestions.summary: Backup-code copy test only checks toast, not clipboard content.
suggestions.content: Copy assertion only waits for toast, never verifies clipboard. If navigator.clipboard.writeText in EnableTwoFactorModal.tsx:278 failed or wrote wrong data, toast-success would still appear and test would pass. Assert clipboard content matches displayed backup codes.
suggestions.summaryPt: O teste de cópia do backup code só verifica o toast, não o conteúdo do clipboard.
suggestions.contentPt: A asserção de cópia apenas espera pelo toast, nunca verifica o clipboard. Se navigator.clipboard.writeText em EnableTwoFactorModal.tsx:278 falhasse ou escrevesse dados errados, o toast-success ainda apareceria e o teste passaria. Valide que o conteúdo do clipboard corresponde aos backup codes exibidos.

suggestions.summary: DisplayBackupCodes reuses entry-field instruction instead of save-instruction
suggestions.content: Description for DisplayBackupCodes reuses t("backup_code_instructions") ('Each backup code can be used exactly once...') which documents the single-code entry field. The DisplayBackupCodes step shows a grid of 10 generated codes to save/copy/download — needs a dedicated key (e.g., backup_codes_save_instructions / 2fa_save_backup_codes). Reusing the entry instruction mis-describes the step and shows wrong user-facing content.
suggestions.summaryPt: DisplayBackupCodes reutiliza a instrução do campo de entrada em vez de uma instrução de salvamento
suggestions.contentPt: A descrição de DisplayBackupCodes reutiliza t("backup_code_instructions") ('Each backup code can be used exactly once...'), que documenta o campo de entrada de um único código. A etapa DisplayBackupCodes mostra uma grade de 10 códigos gerados para salvar/copiar/baixar — precisa de uma key dedicada (ex.: backup_codes_save_instructions / 2fa_save_backup_codes). Reutilizar a instrução de entrada descreve mal a etapa e mostra conteúdo errado para o usuário.

suggestions.summary: Locale keys added only to English file, missing in other locales
suggestions.content: 7 new user-facing keys added only to en/common.json (backup_code, backup_codes, backup_code_instructions, backup_codes_copied, incorrect_backup_code, lost_access, missing_backup_codes). Surrounding code uses t() everywhere, so other locales in apps/web/public/static/locales/*/common.json will miss these keys and fall back to English or show raw keys. Sync keys to all locale files or ensure extraction pipeline creates them.
suggestions.summaryPt: Keys de locale adicionadas apenas ao arquivo em inglês, ausentes nos outros locales
suggestions.contentPt: 7 novas keys visíveis ao usuário foram adicionadas apenas em en/common.json (backup_code, backup_codes, backup_code_instructions, backup_codes_copied, incorrect_backup_code, lost_access, missing_backup_codes). O código ao redor usa t() em todo lugar, então os outros locales em apps/web/public/static/locales/*/common.json não terão essas keys e farão fallback para inglês ou mostrarão as keys cruas. Sincronize as keys em todos os arquivos de locale ou garanta que o pipeline de extração as crie.

suggestions.summary: Backup-code login does non-atomic read-modify-write allowing concurrent reuse of single-use code
suggestions.content: Backup-code verification is read-modify-write without atomicity. Two concurrent authorize() calls with the same backupCode both read the same decrypted array before either writes, both find the same index and both succeed, reusing a single-use code. Wrap the read-check-update in a transaction (or use an atomic WHERE condition / optimistic lock / SELECT FOR UPDATE) so the second concurrent request re-reads after the first commits and sees index -1.
suggestions.summaryPt: O login com backup code faz read-modify-write não atômico, permitindo reutilização concorrente de um código de uso único
suggestions.contentPt: A verificação do backup code é um read-modify-write sem atomicidade. Duas chamadas concorrentes de authorize() com o mesmo backupCode leem o mesmo array descriptografado antes de qualquer uma escrever, ambas encontram o mesmo index e ambas têm sucesso, reutilizando um código de uso único. Envolva o read-check-update em uma transaction (ou use uma condição WHERE atômica / optimistic lock / SELECT FOR UPDATE) para que a segunda requisição concorrente releia após o commit da primeira e veja o index -1.

suggestions.summary: disable() added required backupCode param breaking 2-arg callers; should be optional
suggestions.content: Make the new backupCode parameter optional (`backupCode?: string`) instead of required. This preserves the pre-PR contract `disable(password, code)` for existing callers while still allowing the updated caller in DisableTwoFactorModal to pass the backup code when in lost-access mode. Required param forces every caller to update even when they only use TOTP.
suggestions.summaryPt: disable() adicionou o parâmetro obrigatório backupCode, quebrando chamadores de 2 argumentos; deveria ser opcional
suggestions.contentPt: Torne o novo parâmetro backupCode opcional (`backupCode?: string`) em vez de obrigatório. Isso preserva o contrato pré-PR `disable(password, code)` para chamadores existentes, ao mesmo tempo que permite que o chamador atualizado em DisableTwoFactorModal passe o backup code no modo lost-access. Um parâmetro obrigatório força todo chamador a atualizar mesmo quando só usa TOTP.

suggestions.summary: Component declared as TwoFactor in BackupCode.tsx mismatches file and purpose
suggestions.content: Exported identifier disagrees with file and UI: `export default function TwoFactor` lives in BackupCode.tsx and renders a backup-code field (t("backup_code")). Rename to `BackupCode` to match file name, import alias (`import BackupCode from "@components/auth/BackupCode"`) and displayed content. Mismatch confuses callers and docs.
suggestions.summaryPt: Componente declarado como TwoFactor em BackupCode.tsx não corresponde ao arquivo e à finalidade
suggestions.contentPt: O identificador exportado discorda do arquivo e da UI: `export default function TwoFactor` está em BackupCode.tsx e renderiza um campo de backup code (t("backup_code")). Renomeie para `BackupCode` para corresponder ao nome do arquivo, ao alias de import (`import BackupCode from "@components/auth/BackupCode"`) e ao conteúdo exibido. A divergência confunde chamadores e documentação.

groups.defect: Backup-code consumption in authorize() is a non-atomic read-modify-write, so concurrent logins can reuse the same single-use code; the null entries left behind also pile up and are never reported as MissingBackupCodes.
Backup codes are checked with indexOf/===, which is not constant-time and leaks timing, in both the disable-2FA endpoint and the login authorize path.

Backup-code consumption in authorize() is a non-atomic read-modify-write, so concurrent logins can reuse the same single-use code; the null entries left behind also pile up and are never reported as MissingBackupCodes.
groups.rationale: Both report the same race condition on the backup-code update in next-auth-options.ts. s_cf0c790d also reports the null-hole buildup, so the merged comment needs to cover both defects.

groups.defect: Backup codes are checked with indexOf/===, which is not constant-time and leaks timing, in both the disable-2FA endpoint and the login authorize path.
groups.rationale: It is the same timing-leak mistake copied into two places (disable.ts and next-auth-options.ts). One change, a constant-time comparison, fixes both.

groups.defect: Backup-code verification uses timing-variable indexOf/string comparisons in both the login and disable-2FA paths.
groups.rationale: Both report the same comparison mistake at separate verification sites, each requiring an edit. Their proposed case normalization does not report case sensitivity as a defect and therefore does not link the uppercase-code suggestion.

groups.defect: Non-atomic backup-code consumption permits concurrent reuse, and consumed entries accumulate as nulls without exhausted-code handling.
groups.rationale: Both report the same read-modify-write race in authorize(). The second additionally reports null accumulation and failure to report exhausted codes as missing, which the merged comment must preserve.

suggestions.summary: PollFeed crashes on nil feed content due to unguarded scrub call
suggestions.content: WHAT: `CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` crashes when `i.content` is nil. WHY: SimpleRSS items may omit content/description (rss.items from open/parse on attacker-influenced feed) -> nil.scrub raises NoMethodError and aborts the hourly PollFeed job, preventing all subsequent items from importing. HOW: guard nil: `CGI.unescapeHTML((i.content || "").to_s.scrub)` or `i.content.to_s.scrub` and handle nil i.title similarly.
suggestions.summaryPt: PollFeed quebra com conteúdo nil do feed devido a chamada scrub sem proteção
suggestions.contentPt: O QUÊ: `CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` quebra quando `i.content` é nil. POR QUÊ: itens do SimpleRSS podem omitir content/description (rss.items de open/parse em um feed influenciado por atacante) -> nil.scrub lança NoMethodError e aborta o job horário PollFeed, impedindo a importação de todos os itens seguintes. CORREÇÃO: proteja contra nil: `CGI.unescapeHTML((i.content || "").to_s.scrub)` ou `i.content.to_s.scrub` e trate i.title nil de forma semelhante.

suggestions.summary: embed.js null dereference when target div missing
suggestions.content: WHAT: `document.getElementById('discourse-comments')` can return null then `comments.appendChild(iframe)` throws TypeError. WHY: If embedding site omits the required div or script loads before DOM, null dereference aborts embed and breaks resizing postMessage handler. HOW: guard: `if (!comments) return;` before appendChild.
suggestions.summaryPt: Desreferência nula em embed.js quando a div de destino não existe
suggestions.contentPt: O QUÊ: `document.getElementById('discourse-comments')` pode retornar null e então `comments.appendChild(iframe)` lança TypeError. POR QUÊ: se o site que incorpora omitir a div obrigatória ou o script carregar antes do DOM, a desreferência nula aborta o embed e quebra o handler de postMessage de redimensionamento. CORREÇÃO: proteja: `if (!comments) return;` antes de appendChild.

suggestions.summary: Invalid `end if` ERB syntax breaks embed rendering
suggestions.content: WHAT: `<%- end if %>` is invalid ERB/Ruby syntax. WHY: Causes SyntaxError on render of embed/best when topic_view exists (the `if/else` branch), breaking the embed feature for all users. HOW: change to `<% end %>`.
suggestions.summaryPt: Sintaxe ERB inválida `end if` quebra a renderização do embed
suggestions.contentPt: O QUÊ: `<%- end if %>` é uma sintaxe ERB/Ruby inválida. POR QUÊ: causa SyntaxError ao renderizar embed/best quando topic_view existe (o branch `if/else`), quebrando o recurso de embed para todos os usuários. CORREÇÃO: troque para `<% end %>`.

suggestions.summary: Mutating << on contents breaks on frozen/nil input
suggestions.content:
WHAT: `contents << "
<hr>..."` mutates caller's string and fails on frozen/nil contents. WHY: poll_feed passes i.content-derived string which may be frozen or nil -> FrozenError/NoMethodError; also pollutes caller's variable and SHA is computed over mutated value inconsistently if caller reuses it. HOW: `contents = contents.to_s.dup + "
<hr>..."` or `contents = "#{contents}
<hr>..."`.
suggestions.summaryPt: Mutação com << em contents quebra com entrada frozen/nil
suggestions.contentPt:
O QUÊ: `contents << "
<hr>..."` muta a string do chamador e falha com contents frozen/nil. POR QUÊ: poll_feed passa uma string derivada de i.content que pode ser frozen ou nil -> FrozenError/NoMethodError; também polui a variável do chamador e o SHA é calculado sobre o valor mutado de forma inconsistente se o chamador reutilizá-la. CORREÇÃO: `contents = contents.to_s.dup + "
<hr>..."` ou `contents = "#{contents}
<hr>..."`.

suggestions.summary: Unescaped referer in postMessage targetOrigin enables JS injection and breaks origin check
suggestions.content: WHAT: `request.referer` is interpolated into JS string literal without JS escaping and used as postMessage targetOrigin. WHY: Referer containing `'` or `</script>` breaks out of the string (XSS) and full URL with path is not a valid targetOrigin (should be scheme://host:port), so resize message is dropped by browser; also nil referer becomes empty string. HOW: use `j`/`escape_javascript` and extract origin: `URI(request.referer).host` or `Discourse.base_url` or `'*'` with proper origin check.
suggestions.summaryPt: Referer sem escape no targetOrigin do postMessage permite injeção de JS e quebra a verificação de origem
suggestions.contentPt: O QUÊ: `request.referer` é interpolado em um literal string JS sem escape de JS e usado como targetOrigin do postMessage. POR QUÊ: um Referer contendo `'` ou `</script>` escapa da string (XSS) e a URL completa com path não é um targetOrigin válido (deveria ser scheme://host:port), então a mensagem de resize é descartada pelo navegador; além disso, referer nil vira string vazia. CORREÇÃO: use `j`/`escape_javascript` e extraia a origem: `URI(request.referer).host` ou `Discourse.base_url` ou `'*'` com verificação de origem adequada.

suggestions.summary: Substring origin check is incorrect and bypassable
suggestions.content: WHAT: Origin check `discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin) === -1` is a substring test, not an equality check. WHY: Allows `e.origin = 'discourse'` to pass if discourseUrl contains it, and fails legitimate origins that are substrings of a longer discourseUrl; attacker with host `discourse.example.com.evil.com` may still be blocked but `example.com` substring matches `https://example.com/` leading to acceptance of spoofed origin with extra path/port mismatch. HOW: parse discourseUrl to origin and compare strictly: `new URL(discourseUrl).origin === e.origin` or `e.origin === discourseUrl.replace(/\/.*$/,'')`.
suggestions.summaryPt: Verificação de origem por substring é incorreta e contornável
suggestions.contentPt: O QUÊ: a verificação de origem `discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin) === -1` é um teste de substring, não de igualdade. POR QUÊ: permite que `e.origin = 'discourse'` passe se discourseUrl o contiver, e falha para origens legítimas que são substrings de um discourseUrl mais longo; um atacante com host `discourse.example.com.evil.com` ainda pode ser bloqueado, mas a substring `example.com` casa com `https://example.com/`, levando à aceitação de uma origem forjada com path extra/porta divergente. CORREÇÃO: faça o parse de discourseUrl para obter a origem e compare estritamente: `new URL(discourseUrl).origin === e.origin` ou `e.origin === discourseUrl.replace(/\/.*$/,'')`.

suggestions.summary: Unescaped URL interpolated into translated HTML and rendered via raw_html bypasses escaping, enabling XSS
suggestions.content: Escape url before interpolation into the translated link and do not bypass sanitization with raw_html + raw rendering. Current code injects external url verbatim into HTML and allows ' or javascript: to break out.
suggestions.summaryPt: URL sem escape interpolada em HTML traduzido e renderizada via raw_html ignora o escaping, permitindo XSS
suggestions.contentPt: Faça o escape de url antes de interpolá-la no link traduzido e não contorne a sanitização com raw_html + renderização raw. O código atual injeta a url externa literalmente no HTML e permite que ' ou javascript: escapem do contexto.

suggestions.summary: Hard-coded date format bypasses I18n localization
suggestions.content: Replace hard-coded strftime with I18n.l and a locale-aware format defined in server.en.yml.
suggestions.summaryPt: Formato de data fixo no código ignora a localização do I18n
suggestions.contentPt: Substitua o strftime fixo no código por I18n.l e um formato sensível ao locale definido em server.en.yml.

suggestions.summary: Check-then-create on unique embed_url races: concurrent imports throw RecordNotUnique.
suggestions.content: Race / invariant violation: TopicEmbed.import checks where(embed_url:url).first then creates inside Topic.transaction with create!. Two concurrent imports (e.g., two RetrieveTopic jobs for same embed_url, or PollFeed racing with fetch_http) both see embed.blank? true and both try to create. Second hits unique index on topic_embeds.embed_url => ActiveRecord::RecordNotUnique unhandled (500 / job crash) or, if timing overlaps exists? in TopicRetriever, duplicate Topic/Post creation. Fix by using SELECT FOR UPDATE / advisory lock or rescue RecordNotUnique and reload.
suggestions.summaryPt: Check-then-create em embed_url único gera race: importações concorrentes lançam RecordNotUnique.
suggestions.contentPt: Race / violação de invariante: TopicEmbed.import verifica where(embed_url:url).first e então cria dentro de Topic.transaction com create!. Duas importações concorrentes (por exemplo, dois jobs RetrieveTopic para o mesmo embed_url, ou PollFeed concorrendo com fetch_http) veem embed.blank? true e ambas tentam criar. A segunda atinge o índice único em topic_embeds.embed_url => ActiveRecord::RecordNotUnique não tratado (500 / crash do job) ou, se o timing se sobrepuser a exists? em TopicRetriever, criação duplicada de Topic/Post. Corrija usando SELECT FOR UPDATE / advisory lock ou fazendo rescue de RecordNotUnique e reload.

suggestions.summary: PollFeed crashes on network failure or nil RSS item content.
suggestions.content: Execution break: open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url) and SimpleRSS parsing have no rescue. Any network error (OpenURI::HTTPError, SocketError, Timeout, InvalidURI) or malformed RSS raises and crashes the scheduled job (retry: false). Also rss.items can be nil/empty and i.content can be nil -> CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub) raises NoMethodError. Validate and rescue around open/parse and guard i.content/i.title nil before import.
suggestions.summaryPt: PollFeed quebra em falha de rede ou conteúdo nil de item RSS.
suggestions.contentPt: Quebra de execução: open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url) e o parsing do SimpleRSS não têm rescue. Qualquer erro de rede (OpenURI::HTTPError, SocketError, Timeout, InvalidURI) ou RSS malformado lança exceção e quebra o job agendado (retry: false). Além disso, rss.items pode ser nil/vazio e i.content pode ser nil -> CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub) lança NoMethodError. Valide e faça rescue em torno de open/parse e proteja i.content/i.title nil antes de importar.

suggestions.summary: import_remote crashes on fetch failure or nil Readability content.
suggestions.content: Execution break: import_remote does open(url).read without rescue and assumes Readability returns non-nil title/content. Network errors raise; doc.content can be nil (parse failure, paywall). Then import does contents << "<hr>..." on nil => NoMethodError. Wrap open/Readability in rescue, guard nil content/title, and return nil / log instead of crashing RetrieveTopic job.
suggestions.summaryPt: import_remote quebra em falha de fetch ou conteúdo nil do Readability.
suggestions.contentPt: Quebra de execução: import_remote faz open(url).read sem rescue e assume que o Readability retorna title/content não nil. Erros de rede lançam exceção; doc.content pode ser nil (falha de parse, paywall). Então import faz contents << "<hr>..." em nil => NoMethodError. Envolva open/Readability em rescue, proteja content/title nil e retorne nil / registre log em vez de quebrar o job RetrieveTopic.

suggestions.summary: Inverted substring origin check allows any prefix/empty origin to pass
suggestions.content: The origin validation is inverted: `discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin) === -1` checks if discourseUrl contains e.origin, so any substring of discourseUrl (e.g., "https", "", "example") passes. Flip to an exact origin equality check. Normalize discourseUrl to its origin (strip trailing slash/path) and compare: `e.origin !== expectedOrigin`.
suggestions.summaryPt: Verificação de origem por substring invertida permite que qualquer prefixo/origem vazia passe
suggestions.contentPt: A validação de origem está invertida: `discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin) === -1` verifica se discourseUrl contém e.origin, então qualquer substring de discourseUrl (por exemplo, "https", "", "example") passa. Troque por uma checagem de igualdade exata de origem. Normalize discourseUrl para sua origem (remova barra final/path) e compare: `e.origin !== expectedOrigin`.

suggestions.summary: postMessage targetOrigin uses full request.referer URL instead of origin, so message is dropped
suggestions.content: Writer and reader disagree on origin format. layout/embed.html.erb:11 sends parent.postMessage(..., request.referer) where request.referer is a full URL with path/query. Second arg to postMessage is targetOrigin which must be an origin (scheme://host[:port]) or '*'. Browsers drop message if targetOrigin != target window origin exactly, so with path included message never delivers and resize handler in embed.js never runs. Extract origin from referer or use '*'.
suggestions.summaryPt: O targetOrigin do postMessage usa a URL completa de request.referer em vez da origem, então a mensagem é descartada
suggestions.contentPt: Quem escreve e quem lê discordam sobre o formato da origem. layout/embed.html.erb:11 envia parent.postMessage(..., request.referer), onde request.referer é uma URL completa com path/query. O segundo argumento de postMessage é targetOrigin, que deve ser uma origem (scheme://host[:port]) ou '*'. Os navegadores descartam a mensagem se targetOrigin != origem da janela de destino exatamente, então com o path incluído a mensagem nunca é entregue e o handler de resize em embed.js nunca executa. suggestions.summary: Hardcoded 10.megabytes download cap and unchecked downsize failure leads to truncated or undownsized uploads

suggestions.summary: Missing double-check after Lock and lock held across I/O allows cache clobber and thundering herd
suggestions.content: WHAT: GetWebAssets takes entryPointAssetsCacheMu.Lock() at line 48 without rechecking entryPointAssetsCache after acquiring it, and holds the exclusive lock across readWebAssetsFromFile/readWebAssetsFromCDN file/network I/O. WHY: A waiter that lost the race to populate the cache still recomputes and does `entryPointAssetsCache = result` (line 69); on transient read error result==nil overwrites a valid cached value, corrupting the cache for all subsequent Prod callers and returning error despite cache being available; holding Lock during I/O serializes all misses behind blocking I/O. HOW: Add second check immediately after Lock: `if cfg.Env != setting.Dev && entryPointAssetsCache != nil { defer Unlock already; return entryPointAssetsCache, nil }` and ideally release lock during I/O (copy-on-write / sync.Once / double-checked read-then-lock-then-set pattern).

suggestions.summary: ClientPermissionsV2 uses wrong owner (server.getId()) for resource lookup, always misses per-client resources
suggestions.content: WHAT: hasPermission(ClientModel,String) and hasPermission(String) lookup resources with wrong owner (server.getId() instead of server.getClientId()). WHY: ResourceStore.findByName default owner is server.getClientId() and AdminPermissionsSchema.create uses server.getClientId(); using server.getId() never finds per-client resources (and never finds the "Clients" type resource in the second overload), so per-client permissions are never evaluated and every check falls through to the all-clients fallback or returns false, breaking fine-grained client authz. HOW: Change resourceStore.findByName(server, client.getId(), server.getId()) to resourceStore.findByName(server, client.getId()) or resourceStore.findByName(server, client.getId(), server.getClientId()) and similarly resourceStore.findByName(server, CLIENTS_RESOURCE_TYPE, server.getId()) to getResourceTypeResource or findByName with server.getClientId().
suggestions.summaryPt: ClientPermissionsV2 usa o owner errado (server.getId()) na busca de resources, sempre falhando em encontrar resources por client
suggestions.contentPt: O QUÊ: hasPermission(ClientModel,String) e hasPermission(String) buscam resources com o owner errado (server.getId() em vez de server.getClientId()). POR QUÊ: O owner padrão de ResourceStore.findByName é server.getClientId() e AdminPermissionsSchema.create usa server.getClientId(); usar server.getId() nunca encontra resources por client (e nunca encontra o resource do tipo "Clients" na segunda sobrecarga), então as permissões por client nunca são avaliadas e toda verificação cai no fallback de todos os clients ou retorna false, quebrando a autorização granular de clients. COMO: Altere resourceStore.findByName(server, client.getId(), server.getId()) para resourceStore.findByName(server, client.getId()) ou resourceStore.findByName(server, client.getId(), server.getClientId()) e, de forma similar, resourceStore.findByName(server, CLIENTS_RESOURCE_TYPE, server.getId()) para getResourceTypeResource ou findByName com server.getClientId().

suggestions.summary: Missing resourceId check allows cross-client permission leakage
suggestions.content: WHAT: hasPermission(ClientModel,String) evaluates ResourcePermission but returns true if any granted scope matches expected scope without verifying permission.getResourceId() equals the requested resource's id. WHY: Unlike UserPermissionsV2:135 which checks permission.getResourceId().equals(resource.getId()), ClientPermissionsV2 can be granted by a permission belonging to a different client resource if evaluator returns multiple permissions, causing privilege escalation (permission on client A grants access to client B). HOW: Add guard if (!permission.getResourceId().equals(resource.getId())) continue; before scope check, mirroring UserPermissionsV2.

POR QUÊ: Diferente de UserPermissionsV2:135, que verifica permission.getResourceId().equals(resource.getId()), ClientPermissionsV2 pode ser autorizado por uma permissão pertencente ao resource de outro client se o evaluator retornar múltiplas permissões, causando escalonamento de privilégio (permissão no client A concede acesso ao client B). COMO: Adicione o guard if (!permission.getResourceId().equals(resource.getId())) continue; antes da verificação de scope, espelhando UserPermissionsV2.

suggestions.summary: Re-auth form attributes set on discarded LoginFormsProvider instance
suggestions.content: WHAT: setupReauthenticationInUsernamePasswordFormError sets USERNAME_HIDDEN/REGISTRATION_DISABLED on a LoginFormsProvider that is discarded before rendering. WHY: challenge()/errorChallenge() obtain a new context.form() instance, so the re-auth attributes never reach the response and a failed password during re-auth shows an editable username field and registration link. HOW: Capture the provider once in badPasswordHandler/createErrorResponse (e.g., LoginFormsProvider form = context.form(); set re-auth attributes on that same form; pass it to challenge/errorChallenge or make setupReauthentication accept/return the form instance) so attributes accumulate on the rendered form.
suggestions.summaryPt: Atributos do formulário de re-autenticação definidos em uma instância descartada de LoginFormsProvider
suggestions.contentPt: O QUÊ: setupReauthenticationInUsernamePasswordFormError define USERNAME_HIDDEN/REGISTRATION_DISABLED em um LoginFormsProvider que é descartado antes da renderização. POR QUÊ: challenge()/errorChallenge() obtêm uma nova instância de context.form(), então os atributos de re-autenticação nunca chegam à resposta e uma senha incorreta durante a re-autenticação exibe um campo de usuário editável e o link de registro. CORREÇÃO: Capture o provider uma única vez em badPasswordHandler/createErrorResponse (ex.: LoginFormsProvider form = context.form(); defina os atributos de re-autenticação nesse mesmo form; passe-o para challenge/errorChallenge ou faça setupReauthentication aceitar/retornar a instância do form) para que os atributos se acumulem no form renderizado.

suggestions.summary: Passkey conditional data written to discarded form before createLoginPassword

WHY: Two separate context.form() calls mean the form that received fillContextForm is not the form that creates the login page, breaking the passkey re-auth fix intermittently. HOW: Fill on the same provider that renders: LoginFormsProvider form = context.form(); if (isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(...)) webauthnAuth.fillContextFormUsing(form) or ensure fillContextForm and createLoginPassword use the same form instance; alternatively perform fill immediately before creation on the same instance.
suggestions.summaryPt: Dados condicionais de passkey gravados em form descartado antes de createLoginPassword

POR QUÊ: Duas chamadas separadas a context.form() significam que o form que recebeu fillContextForm não é o form que cria a página de login, quebrando de forma intermitente a correção de re-autenticação com passkey. CORREÇÃO: Preencha no mesmo provider que renderiza: LoginFormsProvider form = context.form(); if (isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(...)) webauthnAuth.fillContextFormUsing(form) ou garanta que fillContextForm e createLoginPassword usem a mesma instância de form; alternativamente, faça o preenchimento imediatamente antes da criação na mesma instância.

WHY: An attacker with session access could satisfy re-auth with a different user's passkey, bypassing the re-authentication check that the original user is present. HOW: When USER_SET_BEFORE_USERNAME_PASSWORD_AUTH is true, restrict the WebAuthn options to that user's credentials (e.g., set allowCredentials to that user's credentialIds) or validate after WebAuthn that the authenticated user equals context.getUser() before success.

POR QUÊ: Um atacante com acesso à sessão poderia satisfazer a re-autenticação com a passkey de outro usuário, contornando a verificação de re-autenticação de que o usuário original está presente. CORREÇÃO: Quando USER_SET_BEFORE_USERNAME_PASSWORD_AUTH for true, restrinja as opções do WebAuthn às credenciais desse usuário (ex.: defina allowCredentials com os credentialIds desse usuário) ou valide após o WebAuthn que o usuário autenticado é igual a context.getUser() antes do sucesso.

suggestions.summary: Extract regex to a constant near the top so every location in this file can reuse the same pattern and casing rules.
suggestions.content:
Creating a class-level `Pattern`/`String` constant enables reuse outside `isValid()` and keeps case normalization in a single place. This avoids duplicated literals if the same `\w` pattern is needed elsewhere.
**Before:**
```java
if (!user.getUsername().matches("\\w+")) { ... }
```
**After:**
```java
private static final Pattern USERNAME_PATTERN = Pattern.compile("\\w+", Pattern.CASE_INSENSITIVE);
...
if (!USERNAME_PATTERN.matcher(user.getUsername()).matches()) { ... }
```
Alternative: keep current parsing logic if the block is performance sensitive, but consider documentation to clarify the exact whitelist semantics.

**Antes:**

**Depois:**

```java
...
```

Alternativa: mantenha a lógica de parsing atual se o bloco for sensível a desempenho, mas considere documentar para esclarecer a semântica exata da whitelist.
